items.summary: Adjust the ElectronHoverLink (PCB track) path routing so the connection track does not “turn” excessively and all bends remain natural with a maximum bend angle of 45° (i.e., only horizontal/vertical segments connected by 45° diagonals, without additional sharper turns or overly aggressive detours).
Slightly reduce the intensity of the ElectronHoverLink glowing/moving visuals (the traveling glow segment and glow head), while preserving the same overall style and timing.
